_readme: L-16 blueprint history (BUG_REPAIR_20261102 §4.3 L-16). This developer-only file records, for every
shipped BoxFarm blueprint, the TemplateName values and the BlockObjectSpec.Size footprints that were
ever distributed (published Workshop releases and the pre-release/test builds whose saves can still
exist). tools/validate reads it and enforces three hard gates (same rules in the L1
test V2BlueprintHistoryContractTests via HDBF.Core.Data.BlueprintHistoryContract):
(a) the current TemplateSpec.TemplateName must appear in publishedTemplateNames;
(b) every historical name other than the current one must appear in the blueprint's
TemplateSpec.BackwardCompatibleTemplateNames, otherwise old saves are deleted by the game as
'not backward compatible';
(c) the current BlockObjectSpec.Size must equal the LAST entry of releases, so a footprint change
cannot ship until it is recorded here (and save-migrated).
UPDATE PROCEDURE (a rename or footprint change is a save-migration red line):
1. Do not delete or rewrite older entries/names - they describe already published saves.
2. Before shipping a TemplateName change: append the new name to publishedTemplateNames and add the
OLD name to the blueprint's BackwardCompatibleTemplateNames (keep both forever).
3. Before shipping a BlockObjectSpec.Size change: append { version, size, note } to that blueprint's
releases; the new entry becomes the new 'last published footprint'. A footprint change also needs
an explicit save-migration review (docs/VERIFICATION.md §25 art04 A/B: the game deletes buildings
whose footprint no longer matches the save, printing 'not backward compatible. Deleting it.').
4. Run build.ps1: tools/validate fails until the blueprints and this file agree exactly.
5. This file is not staged into the mod (only data/ ships); it is read by the validator and the L1
tests only.
EVIDENCE: git history of data/Buildings/Food/BoxFarm (commits ef2b398 = v1 baseline 3x2x1, 8219755 =
v2 3x3x1, later commits unchanged) plus docs/VERIFICATION.md §25 (3x1x2 -> 3x2x1 axis fix with in-game
A/B) and docs/v2/CHANGELOG.md [0.2.0] (3x2x1 -> 3x3x1). The TemplateName values never changed in the
recorded history, so every BackwardCompatibleTemplateNames list stays empty; the gate now protects any
future rename/footprint change.
